tools.name: find_business
tools.description: Look up whether a business already has a suggestion box on SuggestionBox.tips. Use before leaving a message when unsure which business the user means.

tools.name: leave_message
tools.description: Drop the user's feedback (a suggestion, a problem or a compliment) into a business's private suggestion box on SuggestionBox.tips. Only the business reads it. Confirm the wording with the user before sending. Give the website when you know it; otherwise the business name and its city.
